<!-- pr-reviewer: e7a5ed19089deab0f138e7b0c6036a5d40577309 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @mkinney, this is a careful reader.

**What looks good**
- Read-only module with a provenance line citing ISO 10303-42 and the public ISO/TS 13399 pages; no vendor material.
- No unwrap/expect/panic or unchecked indexing in `step_csys.rs`; invalid UTF-8, empty input, syntax errors, missing DATA and bad length units return `ImportError`. Zero-length, non-finite and parallel axes, bad point/direction records, and same-name conflicting placements are refused by name in the report instead of being used.
- `step_units.rs` change is visibility only. No build.rs, scripts, workflows or dependency changes.
- Decision record in `docs/decisions/`, `Refs #370` (honest, since alignment waits for #368), `Changelog: none`, no CHANGELOG edit. Files are under 400 lines.

**Local results (merged with current main; clean merge, no conflicts)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_csys`: 6 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The reader is not wired into anything yet (by design, until #368), so it has no user-visible effect today.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
